package password // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/password"

const (
	MinCharacters = 12
	MaxBytes      = 72
)

func Confirm(out io.Writer, prompt, confirmation string, read func() ([]byte, error)) (string, error)

func Fits(value string) bool

func Validate(value string) error

func WithHiddenInput(fd int, action func() (string, error)) (value string, err error)

type RuleError string

const (
	ErrTooShort RuleError = "Use at least 12 characters."
	ErrTooLong  RuleError = "Use a shorter password."
	ErrInvalid  RuleError = "That password has characters that can't be saved. Try typing it again."
)

func (e RuleError) Error() string

type Source struct {
	Prompt, Stdin bool
	File          string
}

func Flags(flags *flag.FlagSet) *Source

func (s Source) Read(in io.Reader, out io.Writer) (string, error)
